entities.name: Radian Aatchik
entities.description: Wizened insectoid captain of the Speedbrood team in the Ghirapur Grand Prix, a druid of velocity and precision.

entities.name: Speedbrood
entities.description: Insectoid brood whose cohort Aatchik led in the race.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: The race on Avishkar; Aatchik competed in the second annual one.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The plane where the Grand Prix was held.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who mind-controlled Aatchik while trying to recover his adopted child Loot.

events.summary: Aatchik enters her last race as a highmind, hoping to prove herself ready for metamorphosis into a Speedbrood vehicle.
events.quote: This was Aatchik's last race as a highmind

events.summary: In the final stage Aatchik's vehicle is wrecked and she is mind-controlled by Jace Beleren.
events.quote: Aatchik's vehicle was wrecked, and she was mind-controlled by Jace Beleren

relations.quote: she was mind-controlled by Jace Beleren
